answer: Neighborhood Depth Weighting: each agent's influence score is the count of distinct two-hop paths to established nodes, capped per neighbor. A new node enters with a pigment of zero influence until it links to agents that already hold nonzero depth, so buying many leaves adds no weight. The delta between an attacker's raw account count and its effective depth stays near zero, since parallel leaves share the same upstream neighbors. Sybils must instead cultivate deep, sable, aged connections across many independent clusters.
